svg.title: OpenInstinct — CrewAI edition architecture
svg.desc: OpenInstinct, an independent CrewAI implementation inspired by Merit Systems’ original project. Text messages enter through Sendblue and FastAPI, are persisted in Supabase PostgreSQL, and are processed by a CrewAI worker using OpenAI. Replies return through Sendblue. A Python scheduler queues reminders and briefings from saved schedules. Optional Gmail and GitHub accounts connect through Composio MCP. Browserbase and Playwright support public web research. The project is experimental; the Render deployment blueprint is prepared but hosting is not live.
svg.text: Conversation, saved notes, and proactive follow-through.
